text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Navy short pointed collar jacket over high-button navy shirt, charcoal pinstriped wide-leg trousers, black loafers.. Add ONLY these accessories: Black smooth leather belt with simple silver rectangular buckle, complete belt shown in a loose oval.; A silver trouser key chain with hook, short linked chain, key-shaped metal charms and a narrow brown leather tassel, shown detached as one accessory.; A black leather briefcase satchel with two buckled flap straps, top handle and long shoulder strap.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Create ONE complete photorealistic hollow wardrobe outfit on a pure white background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light. FIRST reference is the exact clothing base; preserve its cuts, colors, layers and footwear. Other references are individual accessory products belonging to this look. Garments: Navy short pointed collar jacket over high-button navy shirt, charcoal pinstriped wide-leg trousers, black loafers.. Add EXACTLY these accessories and no others: Black smooth leather belt with simple silver rectangular buckle, complete belt shown in a loose oval.; A silver trouser key chain with hook, short linked chain, key-shaped metal charms and a narrow brown leather tassel, shown detached as one accessory.; A black leather briefcase satchel with two buckled flap straps, top handle and long shoulder strap.. Arrange as a single cohesive empty outfit: tie at collar, belt at waist, scarf draped naturally, hat/eyewear hovering above empty neck if present, necklace around empty collar; bag beside hip with full strap. Watches, gloves or small jewelry can be placed neatly beside outfit, each once. No visible person, body, face, skin, hands, legs, mannequin, stand or hanger. Empty neck and sleeves. Preserve fully visible garments, shoes, accessory shapes, full chains and straps within frame. No source photos, collages, labels, text, props or watermark.
